patches.name: Walk-and-win step spoof
patches.description: Report a fixed step count (10000) to walk-and-win instead of the real sensor value. Rewards are issued server-side and may still require genuine activity.

patches.name: Play license bypass
patches.description: Skip the Play Store install and signature checks so the patched app launches instead of redirecting to the Play Store.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlock premium-gated UI and the ad-free match flow. Features validated server-side may still require a subscription.
